battery.rule: REJECT iff |m_hat_k - m_bar_k| > delta_k for any k in {0,1,2} OR interval-Hankel H1=[[m0,m1],[m1,m2]] infeasible (min eig < -tol) OR m1 interval entirely < -tol.
battery.shot_model: m_hat_k ~ Normal(m_exact_k, sigma_k^2); sigma_k = z * local-estimator standard error of the DEVICE-SIDE PREPARED state at Ns shots (honesty fix: prepared, possibly-truncated, state -- NOT the exact |0>).

decision_prereg: Primary endpoint: TPR (reject | corrupted) and FPR (reject | clean) at the frozen thresholds. Secondary: per-mode catch rate, expected to be high for trunc / nl=1 krylov / non-preserving ac and LOW (by design) for nl>=2 krylov and m0-preserving ac. FPR target ~ nominal joint 1-(1-0.05)^3.

ac.desc: analytic-continuation artefact; m_bar = m_exact + a spurious Gaussian atom (random freq/weight), renormalized to preserve m0 with prob 0.5 (the moment-preserving subclass is designed-blind).

krylov.desc: under-converged Krylov; m_bar = nl-node Lanczos representation (exact through m_{2nl-1}); nl in {1,2,3,4}

trunc.desc: SQD/determinant-subspace truncation; m_bar = moments of the truncated-subspace reconstruction; d ~ U[0.15,0.75]*nsup

system.probe: current operator J; T=0 Lehmann measure

title: Blind pre-registered falsification harness for reconstruction-independent moment screen
